title: SQL sync adapter: add method or optimize query for bulk-updates
description: The SQL sync adapter's create/update method is currently best-suited to updating a single model at a time. The query could be optimized, or a separate method could be added to make bulk updates (multiple models in a single operation) so that such changes could be done in a more performant method.    Options might include     - update REPLACE INTO query to pass multiple VALUES  - execute multiple queries, but wrap in transaction so that there's a single atomic operation on the DB    A transaction should be used in either case to provide recovery in the case of an error during the update.
